Privacy.

The boring part. But it matters, so it's here.

Who handles the data

NÍTIDA Digital. MAU Marketing is a NÍTIDA Digital brand. Contact: ola@maumarketing.pt.

What data we collect

What you give us in the contact form: name, email and message. If you accept cookies, Google Analytics collects usage data: pages viewed, where you came from, device and approximate location. We use no advertising cookies.

What it is for

Replying to your message, preparing proposals, delivering the services you hire and, if you accept cookies, understanding how the site is used. We never sell data to anyone.

Legal basis

Your consent (when you submit the form or accept cookies) and pre-contractual steps taken at your request, under the GDPR.

How long we keep it

Up to 24 months after the last contact. If you become a client, for the duration of the contract and the applicable legal periods (for example, tax). Google Analytics data is kept for at most 14 months.

Who we share it with

EmailJS, which sends the form messages (a service based outside the EU); Google, through Google Analytics, only if you accept cookies (it may transfer data outside the EU); our email provider; and the site hosting. Google Fonts loads the site fonts, so your IP address is visible to Google.

Cookies

We only use the Google Analytics cookies (_ga and _ga_*, up to 2 years), and only after you accept them in the notice. Your choice is stored in your browser and you can change it any time under “Cookies” in the footer.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. To exercise any of them, write to ola@maumarketing.pt. You can also complain to the Portuguese data protection authority, CNPD (cnpd.pt), or use the Complaints Book.
